name: KHFM Hospitality & Facility Management Services Ltd.
summary: KHFM Hospitality & Facility Management Services Ltd. is an India-based company specializing in integrated facility management, hospitality management, and human resource solutions. The company provides a broad range of services including housekeeping, pest control, security, gardening, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, solid waste management, and various cleaning services. Its hospitality offerings encompass industrial and corporate catering, and guest house management. KHFM primarily serves public and private sector clients across India, with a focus on government and municipal contracts, high-traffic environments like railway stations, airports, and hospitals, as well as corporate offices, educational institutions, and residential properties.
